## About

ImeriClima has provided residential and commercial air conditioner services in the Imereti region since 2017. The company specializes in installation, maintenance, diagnostics, repair, antibacterial cleaning, and system relocation.

## Core Services

- Air Conditioner Installation
- Air Conditioner Dismantling & Relocation
- Air Conditioner Cleaning & Disinfection
- Freon Refill
- Diagnostics & Repair
- PCB & Electronic Board Repair
